remainingBlockers.reason: Two bounded staging attempts produced no running browser container or exact runtime attestation: quota rejected the first before pod creation and the second expired while pulling the image.

Static retrieval and network-policy controls ran, but the deployed browser path and full staging robots, rebinding, redirect, MIME, decompression, cancellation and private-target transcript remain incomplete.
The corpus includes hostile query text and repository fixtures preserve hostile page text, but no malicious live page was successfully executed through the staging browser boundary.

Persistent staging storage proved miss, fresh hit and disclosed stale reuse, but the cache probe is not yet integrated as read-through behavior in connected search and removal/denylist staging invalidation was not run.
Language and region were schema-bound and propagated; the adapters echoed region but did not prove that every upstream truthfully honors locale rather than merely receiving it.
N4.27-owned deployed mock discovery, challenge, receipt and replay evidence remains absent and the route is intentionally non-payable.
Default-deny policies and private/metadata exclusions deployed, but no running browser existed for the complete authenticated staging adversarial suite.
Clervo did not beat its simple-combination baseline on recall or precision, and the SearXNG baseline was rate-limited; no material named-workflow superiority is proven.
Real payment, facilitator verification, settlement and USDC spending were prohibited; the paid route remains non-payable.

Budget, quota, unsafe-ceiling, circuit-open, route-removal and kill-switch stops passed, but no half-open circuit restoration exists, browser-minute cost is unmeasured, and per-route/per-domain concurrency is declared rather than enforced by the staging runtime.
